name: Deno Sandbox
description: Deno's managed microVM sandboxes with credential and egress controls.
descriptionZh: Deno 的托管 microVM 沙箱，含凭据与出站网络控制。
keyFact: Deno Sandbox, announced by Ryan Dahl on 3 February 2026, runs lightweight Firecracker microVMs that start in under a second; secrets are never placed in the environment — placeholders are substituted at the outbound host — and network egress is restricted through an allowlist proxy.
keyFactZh: Deno Sandbox 由 Ryan Dahl 于 2026 年 2 月 3 日发布，运行轻量级 Firecracker microVM、启动低于 1 秒；密钥不进入环境变量（以占位符在出站主机处替换），出站网络通过 allowlist 代理限制。
caveat: Managed-only; the platform is proprietary and the SDK is MIT.
caveatZh: 仅托管，平台为专有，SDK 为 MIT。
